entries.en: Constant ridicule can disempower students who are afraid to speak.
entries.zh: 不断的嘲笑会使那些不敢发言的学生更失去自信。

entries.en: The company plans to regionalize its sales teams next year.
entries.zh: 这家公司计划明年按地区划分销售团队。

entries.en: The veterinarian sent the suspected screwworm to a specialist laboratory.
entries.zh: 兽医把那只疑似旋丽蝇幼虫送到了专业实验室。

entries.en: He stared broodingly at the unopened letter on his desk.
entries.zh: 他满怀忧思地盯着桌上那封尚未拆开的信。

entries.meaningZh: 街头打斗；暴力行为〔英式俚语〕
entries.en: The shopkeeper closed early to avoid the bovver outside.
entries.zh: 店主提早关了门，以避开外面的街头打斗。

entries.en: She spoke calculatedly slowly to give the interpreter time.
entries.zh: 她刻意放慢语速，给口译员留出时间。

entries.meaningZh: 亿万富翁〔夸张、非正式用语〕
entries.en: You needn't be a zillionaire to enjoy a weekend here.
entries.zh: 你不必是亿万富翁，也能在这里享受一个周末。

entries.en: The artist painted a reticulated pattern across the ceramic tiles.
entries.zh: 艺术家在瓷砖上画了一片网状图案。

entries.en: The microscope revealed filamentary structures within the sample.
entries.zh: 显微镜显示样本内部有一些细丝状结构。

entries.en: It was an uncalculated gesture of kindness, not a publicity stunt.
entries.zh: 那是一个不假思索的善意举动，而不是宣传噱头。

entries.en: The painter applied a warm imprimatura before sketching the figures.
entries.zh: 画家在勾画人物之前，先涂上了一层暖色底色。

entries.en: The ambassador preferred quiet negotiations to the spectacle of summitry.
entries.zh: 比起首脑会晤的盛大场面，大使更喜欢低调谈判。

entries.en: We lowered a hydrophone from the boat to record underwater sounds.
entries.zh: 我们从船上放下水中听音器，记录水下的声音。

entries.en: The factory's reconversion to civilian production took several months.
entries.zh: 工厂恢复民用生产用了几个月时间。

entries.en: The restored fireplace has a decorated iron fireback.
entries.zh: 修复后的壁炉装有一块带装饰的铁炉板。

entries.en: The research examines dysregulation of the body's temperature control.
entries.zh: 这项研究考察了人体体温调节的失调现象。

entries.meaningZh: 整体的〔holistic 的异体拼写〕
entries.en: The team took a wholistic approach to the school's problems.
entries.zh: 团队从整体出发处理学校的问题。

entries.en: The engineers inspected the arch before decentering began.
entries.zh: 工程师们在开始拆卸拱架前检查了拱。

entries.en: The diagram shows changing interatomic distances as the molecule bends.
entries.zh: 图中显示了分子弯曲时原子间距离的变化。

entries.en: She is a vivid describer of life in remote villages.
entries.zh: 她善于生动地描写偏远村落的生活。

entries.en: The historian studied millennialism among several nineteenth-century religious communities.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了几个十九世纪宗教团体中的千禧年说。

entries.en: I left my coat at the laundrette around the corner.
entries.zh: 我把外套落在拐角处的自动洗衣店了。

entries.en: The report described the dysfunctionality of the ageing control system.
entries.zh: 报告描述了老化控制系统的功能紊乱。

entries.en: The roaster blended robusta with a milder coffee variety.
entries.zh: 烘焙师把粗壮咖啡豆与另一种味道较温和的咖啡豆混合。

entries.en: The fabric had a bluey tint under the fluorescent light.
entries.zh: 这块布在荧光灯下泛着淡蓝色。

entries.meaningZh: 人脑〔计算机领域戏称“湿件”〕
entries.en: Even excellent software needs human wetware to interpret the results.
entries.zh: 即使软件十分出色，也需要人脑来解读结果。

entries.en: The recorded pressure decreased monotonically throughout the test.
entries.zh: 记录到的压力在整个测试过程中单调下降。

entries.en: The exhibition traced the institution's aggiornamento through its changing publications.
entries.zh: 展览通过该机构出版物的变化，展示了它的现代化历程。

entries.en: The novel imagines a superluminal spacecraft crossing the galaxy.
entries.zh: 这部小说设想了一艘穿越银河系的超光速飞船。

entries.en: The technician labelled the container holding the neutralizer.
entries.zh: 技术员给装有中和剂的容器贴上了标签。

entries.en: That deserted tunnel was the creepiest place we visited.
entries.zh: 那条废弃隧道是我们去过的最令人毛骨悚然的地方。

entries.en: Her interest in videography began with filming local wildlife.
entries.zh: 她对摄像的兴趣始于拍摄当地野生动物。

entries.en: He rewound the tape to hear the last sentence again.
entries.zh: 他把磁带倒回去，又听了一遍最后那句话。

entries.en: The detective found a codebook hidden beneath the radio.
entries.zh: 侦探在无线电台下面找到了一本隐藏的电报密码本。

entries.en: The exhibition explores moderne through furniture, posters, and household objects.
entries.zh: 展览通过家具、海报和家居用品来探讨现代风格。

entries.en: The museum preserves ethnobotanical records of traditional plant use.
entries.zh: 博物馆保存着有关植物传统用途的民族植物学记录。

entries.meaningZh: 人种音乐学；民族音乐学
entries.en: She combines field recordings with archival research in ethnomusicology.
entries.zh: 她在民族音乐学研究中将实地录音与档案研究相结合。

entries.en: The textbook includes photographs of different incisional wounds.
entries.zh: 教科书中有不同切口创伤的照片。

entries.en: Our neighbour cleared the pavement with a snowblower.
entries.zh: 邻居用吹雪机清除了人行道上的积雪。

entries.meaningZh: 对救世主即将降临的信仰
entries.en: The book examines messianism in a small religious movement.
entries.zh: 这本书研究了一个小型宗教运动中对救世主即将降临的信仰。

entries.en: He pulled the hood of his djellaba over his head.
entries.zh: 他把带风帽外衣的帽兜拉到了头上。

entries.en: She chose a tankini for the family beach holiday.
entries.zh: 她为全家的海滨假期选了一套坦基尼泳装。

entries.en: Dry, crackly leaves covered the garden path.
entries.zh: 花园小径上铺着踩起来沙沙作响的干叶。

entries.en: The abandoned coalmine now houses a small local museum.
entries.zh: 那座废弃煤矿如今成了一家小型地方博物馆。

entries.en: The laboratory tested the strength of a nanostructured coating.
entries.zh: 实验室测试了一种纳米结构涂层的强度。

entries.en: The lecture introduced experiments investigating superfluidity at extremely low temperatures.
entries.zh: 这堂课介绍了在极低温度下研究超流动性的实验。

entries.en: In the tale, the carved stone was believed to hold mana.
entries.zh: 在这个故事中，人们相信那块雕刻的石头具有超自然力量。

entries.en: The passengers settled into the tonneau of the old touring car.
entries.zh: 乘客们在那辆老式敞篷旅行车的后部乘坐区坐下。

entries.en: They hosted a small musicale in their drawing room.
entries.zh: 他们在客厅里举办了一场小型社交音乐会。

entries.en: A dispute over seats turned into a donnybrook outside the hall.
entries.zh: 一场座位争执在大厅外演变成了闹哄哄的混战。

entries.en: The character angrily called the filthy toilet a shithouse.
entries.zh: 那个角色愤怒地用粗俗的说法称那间脏厕所为“粪坑”。

entries.en: The publicness of the hearing made the witnesses nervous.
entries.zh: 听证会的公开性让证人们感到紧张。

entries.en: A small workboat carried supplies to the harbour crew.
entries.zh: 一艘小工作船为港口工作人员运送物资。

entries.en: The pacy thriller kept us watching until the credits rolled.
entries.zh: 这部节奏紧凑的惊悚片让我们一直看到片尾字幕出现。

entries.en: The research team collected measurements of tropospheric air pollution.
entries.zh: 研究团队收集了对流层空气污染的测量数据。

entries.meaningZh: 在所属机关外工作的人
entries.en: Each outworker received materials from the central workshop.
entries.zh: 每位在外工作的工人都从中央车间领取了材料。

entries.en: The carpenter checked the frame's mitred corners before applying glue.
entries.zh: 木匠在涂胶之前检查了框架斜接的角部。

entries.en: She began the song in a soft, quavery voice.
entries.zh: 她用轻柔而颤抖的声音唱起了歌。

entries.en: The cabinet held creamware decorated with delicate green leaves.
entries.zh: 柜子里放着绘有精细绿叶图案的米色陶器。

entries.en: The brewer cleaned the fermenter before starting another batch.
entries.zh: 酿酒师在开始酿制下一批酒之前清洗了发酵罐。

entries.en: The medical archive contained records of disarticulation and subsequent rehabilitation.
entries.zh: 医学档案中存有关节断离术及术后康复的记录。

entries.en: The new nanoscience centre brings together chemists, physicists, and engineers.
entries.zh: 新建的纳米科学中心汇集了化学家、物理学家和工程师。

entries.meaningZh: 不平等的；赞成不平等的
entries.en: Critics argued that the policy reflected an inegalitarian view of society.
entries.zh: 批评者认为，这项政策体现了一种赞成社会不平等的观念。

entries.meaningZh: 充满；丰富〔fullness 的异体拼写〕
entries.en: The singer's voice gained fulness as she grew more confident.
entries.zh: 随着信心增强，这位歌手的嗓音变得更加饱满。

entries.en: The study compared the transmissibility of two closely related viruses.
entries.zh: 这项研究比较了两种密切相关的病毒的传染性。

entries.en: The laboratory examined samples from patients with a coinfection.
entries.zh: 实验室检查了同时感染两种病原体的患者的样本。

entries.en: The old fishman repaired his nets beside the river.
entries.zh: 老渔夫在河边修补渔网。

entries.en: My flatmate is a neatnik who labels every kitchen drawer.
entries.zh: 我的室友是个爱整洁的人，给厨房每个抽屉都贴了标签。

entries.en: The historian interviewed an Orangeman about the organisation's local traditions.
entries.zh: 历史学家就该组织的地方传统采访了一位奥兰治党员。

entries.meaningZh: 古罗马或中世纪的教师
entries.en: The medieval magister gathered his pupils for their morning lesson.
entries.zh: 那位中世纪教师把学生们召集起来上早课。

entries.en: She hung a length of colourful ikat beside the window.
entries.zh: 她在窗边挂了一段色彩鲜艳的扎染色织物。

entries.en: The students measured how quickly the plants photosynthesize under different lights.
entries.zh: 学生们测量了这些植物在不同光照下进行光合作用的速率。

entries.en: We found two dormice asleep inside the nesting box.
entries.zh: 我们在巢箱里发现了两只睡着的睡鼠。

entries.meaningZh: 未制成形的；未经加工的
entries.en: Blocks of unworked stone lay beside the sculptor's tools.
entries.zh: 雕刻家的工具旁放着几块未经加工的石料。

entries.meaningZh: 便宜的；不值钱的〔非正式〕
entries.en: This cheapo umbrella broke during the first heavy shower.
entries.zh: 这把便宜雨伞在第一场大雨中就坏了。

entries.en: The micrograph shows a cribriform structure with many small openings.
entries.zh: 显微照片显示了一种有许多小孔的筛状结构。

entries.en: She explained brokenly what had happened during the storm.
entries.zh: 她断断续续地讲述了暴风雨期间发生的事。

entries.en: The builders repaired the damaged blockwork around the doorway.
entries.zh: 建筑工人修补了门口周围受损的砌块墙体。

entries.en: Cleaning revealed an earlier face beneath the later overpainting.
entries.zh: 清理后，后期复绘层下面显露出了一张更早的人脸。

entries.en: The lawyer challenged the claim that her client was deportable.
entries.zh: 律师对其当事人可被驱逐出境的说法提出了异议。

entries.en: They played footsie under the table throughout dinner.
entries.zh: 吃晚饭时，他们一直在桌下用脚相碰来调情。

entries.meaningZh: 农民；乡下人〔西班牙语借词〕
entries.en: The novel follows a young paisano seeking work in the city.
entries.zh: 这部小说讲述了一位年轻乡下人到城里找工作的经历。

entries.en: A blocked printhead left faint stripes across the page.
entries.zh: 堵塞的印字头在纸上留下了淡淡的条纹。

entries.en: The course introduced an undecidable problem in theoretical computing.
entries.zh: 课程介绍了理论计算中的一个不可判定问题。

entries.en: Her successful campaign brought her the mayorship of her hometown.
entries.zh: 她竞选成功，获得了家乡的市长职位。

entries.en: The new megaplex shows films on more than a dozen screens.
entries.zh: 新建的超级影院有十几个放映厅放映电影。

entries.en: The mechanic removed the ice-cream machine's dasher for cleaning.
entries.zh: 机械师卸下了冰淇淋机的搅拌装置进行清洗。

entries.en: The knob's knurled surface made it easier to grip.
entries.zh: 旋钮表面的凸起纹理使它更容易握住。

entries.en: A damaged wheel forced him to retire from the first moto.
entries.zh: 车轮损坏迫使他退出了第一轮摩托车越野赛预赛。

entries.en: One gumboot stuck in the thick mud beside the gate.
entries.zh: 一只橡胶靴陷进了大门旁的厚泥里。

entries.en: The two trees look similar but are botanically quite distinct.
entries.zh: 这两棵树外形相似，但从植物学角度看很不相同。

entries.en: The researchers counted apoptotic cells in the stained tissue sample.
entries.zh: 研究人员统计了染色组织样本中的凋亡细胞。

entries.meaningZh: 同时涉及社会和宗教的
entries.en: The study examines socioreligious changes in the growing town.
entries.zh: 这项研究考察了这座不断发展的城镇在社会和宗教方面的变化。

entries.en: The dentist used an intraoral camera to photograph the damaged tooth.
entries.zh: 牙医用口内摄像机拍摄了受损的牙齿。

entries.en: The bundler tied the newspapers into stacks for delivery.
entries.zh: 捆束机把报纸扎成一摞摞，以便配送。

entries.en: My grandfather practises qigong in the park each morning.
entries.zh: 祖父每天早晨都在公园里练气功。

entries.meaningZh: 是；曾是〔古体，与 thou 连用〕
entries.en: Thou wast the only friend who stayed beside me.
entries.zh: 汝是当时唯一留在我身边的朋友。

entries.en: The family gathered at home for the baby's bris.
entries.zh: 一家人聚在家里，参加婴儿的割礼仪式。

entries.en: The fisherwoman brought her morning catch to the harbour market.
entries.zh: 女渔民把早晨的渔获送到了港口市场。

entries.en: The memoir conveys the author's sense of apartness from her neighbours.
entries.zh: 这本回忆录传达了作者与邻居之间的疏离感。

entries.en: She spread soft cheese on a piece of crispbread.
entries.zh: 她在一片薄脆饼干上涂了软奶酪。

entries.en: The architect replaced the ambitious sketch with a buildable design.
entries.zh: 建筑师用一个切实可建造的设计替换了原先雄心勃勃的草图。

entries.meaningZh: 颠覆性地；以挑战现有秩序的方式
entries.en: The satire works subversively beneath its cheerful surface.
entries.zh: 这部讽刺作品在欢快的表象下，以颠覆性的方式发挥作用。

entries.en: The children fed carrots to the patient old neddy.
entries.zh: 孩子们给那头温顺的老驴喂胡萝卜。

entries.en: A narrow airshaft carried fresh air into the tunnel.
entries.zh: 一条狭窄的通风井把新鲜空气送进了隧道。

entries.en: The laboratory measured how evenly the dopant spread through the material.
entries.zh: 实验室测量了掺杂剂在材料中的分布是否均匀。

entries.en: He sprinkled wheatgerm over his yoghurt before breakfast.
entries.zh: 吃早饭前，他在酸奶上撒了些小麦胚芽。

entries.en: The collector wound the old stemwinder before placing it in the case.
entries.zh: 收藏家给那只老式转柄上链表上好发条，然后把它放进盒子里。

entries.en: The young trialist impressed the coaches with her speed.
entries.zh: 这位年轻的选拔赛参选者凭借速度给教练们留下了深刻印象。

entries.en: We ordered cioppino and extra bread at the waterfront restaurant.
entries.zh: 我们在海滨餐厅点了意式海鲜汤，又加了些面包。

entries.en: The microscope showed a single myocyte beside the marked fibre.
entries.zh: 显微镜下，标记的纤维旁有一个肌细胞。

entries.en: Her essay contrasts a theocentric worldview with a human-centred one.
entries.zh: 她的文章比较了以上帝为中心的世界观与以人为中心的世界观。

entries.en: The pupils chose a makeable design that required only cardboard and glue.
entries.zh: 学生们选了一个只需硬纸板和胶水就能制作的设计。

entries.en: The beekeeper scraped a small piece of propolis from the frame.
entries.zh: 养蜂人从蜂框上刮下了一小块蜂胶。

entries.en: The pathologist examined an epidermoid cyst in the tissue sample.
entries.zh: 病理学家检查了组织样本中的一个表皮样囊肿。

entries.en: The host filled the glass punchbowl before the guests arrived.
entries.zh: 主人在客人到来之前把玻璃潘趣酒碗装满了。

entries.en: The experiment measured the effects of gene overexpression in cultured cells.
entries.zh: 实验测量了培养细胞中基因过量表达的影响。

entries.en: Several unmounted photographs lay on the photographer's desk.
entries.zh: 摄影师的桌上放着几张尚未装框的照片。

entries.en: The mechanic checked whether the old van was still roadworthy.
entries.zh: 机械师检查了那辆旧货车是否仍适合上路。

entries.en: Thick clumps of marram grew along the sandy ridge.
entries.zh: 一丛丛茂密的滨草沿着沙脊生长。

entries.en: The editor published an anticlerical essay that provoked a heated debate.
entries.zh: 编辑发表了一篇反对教权的文章，引发了激烈辩论。

entries.en: A narrow road followed the river through the broad strath.
entries.zh: 一条窄路沿着河流穿过宽阔的平底河谷。

entries.en: The film takes viewers into the microworld inside a drop of water.
entries.zh: 这部影片带领观众进入一滴水内部的微观世界。

entries.meaningZh: 书籍卷首或卷尾的空页
entries.en: She wrote a birthday message on the book's front endpaper.
entries.zh: 她在书的前衬页上写了一句生日祝福。

entries.meaningZh: 尤克里里琴〔ukulele 的异体拼写〕
entries.en: He carried a small ukelele to the beach gathering.
entries.zh: 他带着一把小尤克里里琴去参加海滩聚会。

entries.en: The historical map marks a bridewell beside the old courthouse.
entries.zh: 这张历史地图在旧法院旁标出了一所拘留所。

entries.en: The papermaker lifted a fresh sheet from the mould.
entries.zh: 造纸工从抄纸帘上揭下了一张新纸。

entries.en: A sparrowhawk landed on the fence beyond the garden.
entries.zh: 一只雀鹰落在了花园外的围栏上。

entries.en: The producer asked her to overdub a second vocal line.
entries.zh: 制作人请她在原录音上叠录第二条人声声部。

entries.en: The committee's sessional reports were stored in the parliamentary archive.
entries.zh: 委员会的会期报告保存在议会档案馆里。

entries.en: A lone grazer moved slowly through the tall grass.
entries.zh: 一只落单的食草动物在高草丛中慢慢移动。

entries.en: The model treats the price as exogenously determined.
entries.zh: 这个模型将价格视为外生决定的。

entries.meaningZh: 知识渊博的〔knowledgeable 的异体拼写〕
entries.en: Our knowledgable guide answered questions about every building on the tour.
entries.zh: 我们那位知识渊博的导游回答了有关游览中每栋建筑的问题。

entries.en: The dog's slobbery greeting left wet marks on my sleeve.
entries.zh: 狗流着口水来欢迎我，在我的袖子上留下了湿印。

entries.en: The bathroom was the steamiest room in the house after his shower.
entries.zh: 他洗完澡后，浴室成了屋里水汽最浓的房间。

entries.en: The restaurant grows its salad leaves hydroponically in a small greenhouse.
entries.zh: 这家餐厅在一座小温室里用水培方式种植沙拉用的叶菜。

entries.en: She peeled a chayote and sliced it for the soup.
entries.zh: 她给一个佛手瓜削了皮，切片用来煮汤。

entries.en: The dispute concerned competing possessory claims to the same piece of land.
entries.zh: 这场纠纷涉及对同一块土地相互冲突的占有权主张。

entries.en: An experienced racegoer explained the programme to the newcomers.
